mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, IFNULL(u.user_name, CONCAT('用户', m.user_id)) AS userName, IFNULL(u.phone, '') AS phone, SUBSTRING(m.content, 1, 80) AS lastContent, DATE_FORMAT(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastTime, IFNULL(unread.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount FROM kefu_chat_message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM kefu_chat_message GROUP BY user_id ) latest ON m.id = latest.max_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(1) AS unread_count FROM kefu_chat_message WHERE sender_role = 'user' AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) unread ON unread.user_id = m.user_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
